chunks: “The bathhouse is an undesirable place: it tears away privacy and exposes the private parts. Yet the bathhouse is a good place: it reminds one of the heat of the Fire.”

key_terms.السِّتْرَ: covering or privacy that conceals the body
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, i.e. Hellfire in context
key_terms.الْعَوْرَةَ: the private parts that must be concealed
key_terms.حَرَّ: the heat or burning intensity of

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام describe the bathhouse as both blameworthy and good?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام describes the bathhouse from two angles. It is blameworthy because it can expose a person’s privacy and private parts, yet praiseworthy because its heat can remind one of the heat of Hellfire and thus awaken moral awareness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.239 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
'The bathhouse is an undesirable place; it removes coverings (privacy) and exposes the private parts. However, it is a good place as it reminds one of the heats of the Fire (Hellfire).'.
